$description: RichTextEditor (platform/components/RichTextEditor), library wave 6, lane C: its component tokens. The frame is the text field's (the input tokens), the editing area is RichText compact, the mentions list is the combobox list (a menu surface): nothing of its own look.

rich-text-editor-max-width.$description: RichTextEditor: its widest (a comfortable reading width for the compact text).

rich-text-editor-border-width.$description: RichTextEditor frame: the border width, and the divider under the toolbar.

rich-text-editor-hover-border-color.$description: RichTextEditor frame: the border under the pointer.

rich-text-editor-focus-border-color.$description: RichTextEditor frame: the border while the area or the toolbar has focus (no ring outside it).

rich-text-editor-invalid-border-color.$description: RichTextEditor frame: the border when the content is invalid, kept while focused.

rich-text-editor-read-only-background.$description: RichTextEditor read-only: the read-only field's sunken fill.

rich-text-editor-disabled-background.$description: RichTextEditor disabled: the disabled field's fill.

rich-text-editor-toolbar-border-color.$description: RichTextEditor toolbar: the divider between the toolbar and the area.

rich-text-editor-toolbar-padding-block.$description: RichTextEditor toolbar: the space above and below its buttons.

rich-text-editor-toolbar-padding-inline.$description: RichTextEditor toolbar: the space at its sides.

rich-text-editor-link-bar-gap.$description: RichTextEditor link field: the space between the address and its buttons.

rich-text-editor-area-min-height.$description: RichTextEditor area: its smallest height (about five lines of compact text).

rich-text-editor-area-max-height.$description: RichTextEditor area: its largest height; past it the area scrolls inside.

rich-text-editor-area-padding-block.$description: RichTextEditor area: the text area's padding above and below.

rich-text-editor-area-padding-inline.$description: RichTextEditor area: the text field's side padding.

rich-text-editor-placeholder-text.$description: RichTextEditor area: the hint in the empty area (the placeholder's color).

rich-text-editor-hidden-selection.$description: RichTextEditor area: no visible caret or selection highlight while the engine selects a whole node (ProseMirror-hideselection).

rich-text-editor-mention-text.$description: RichTextEditor mention: a mentioned person or item in the text (the link role, as the combobox's chosen option).

rich-text-editor-mention-font-weight.$description: RichTextEditor mention: semibold, one unit in the text.

rich-text-editor-mentions-background.$description: RichTextEditor mentions list: the menu surface (the combobox list's).

rich-text-editor-mentions-border-color.$description: RichTextEditor mentions list: its border (the combobox list's).

rich-text-editor-mentions-border-width.$description: RichTextEditor mentions list: its border width (the combobox list's).

rich-text-editor-mentions-radius.$description: RichTextEditor mentions list: its corners (the combobox list's).

rich-text-editor-mentions-text.$description: RichTextEditor mentions list: the options' color (the combobox option's).

rich-text-editor-mentions-max-height.$description: RichTextEditor mentions list: its largest height (the combobox list's).

rich-text-editor-mentions-min-width.$description: RichTextEditor mentions list: its smallest width.

rich-text-editor-mentions-padding-block.$description: RichTextEditor mentions list: the space above and below the options (the combobox list's).

rich-text-editor-mentions-padding-inline.$description: RichTextEditor mentions list: the space at its sides (the combobox list's).

rich-text-editor-mentions-layer.$description: RichTextEditor mentions list: above the page where it is not in the top layer (the combobox list's).

rich-text-editor-mention-option-radius.$description: RichTextEditor mentions option: its corners (the combobox option's).

rich-text-editor-mention-option-font-siz.$description: RichTextEditor mentions option: its text size (the combobox option's).

rich-text-editor-mention-option-min-heig.$description: RichTextEditor mentions option: its height (the combobox option's).

rich-text-editor-mention-option-padding-.$description: RichTextEditor mentions option: its side padding (the combobox option's).

rich-text-editor-mention-option-active-b.$description: RichTextEditor mentions option: the active option's fill (the combobox option's).

rich-text-editor-groups-height.$description: RichTextEditor toolbar: the height of its one row of groups (the toolbar control height); groups past it move into More formatting.

rich-text-editor-groups-gap.$description: RichTextEditor toolbar: the space between its groups (the toolbar's group gap).

rich-text-editor-swatches-gap.$description: RichTextEditor color field: the space between the suggested color swatches.

rich-text-editor-hex-width.$description: RichTextEditor color field: the width of the hex value field.

rich-text-editor-picker-width.$description: RichTextEditor color field: the width of the browser's color input (a square at the control height).

rich-text-editor-selected-cell-backgroun.$description: RichTextEditor table: the cells of a table selection (the selected row fill of the Plenix table).

rich-text-editor-selected-node-outline-c.$description: RichTextEditor image: the outline of a selected image (the focus color).

rich-text-editor-selected-node-outline-w.$description: RichTextEditor image: the width of a selected image's outline (the focus outline width).
